title: Application Engineering Specialist - AI & Full Stack ( 4 to 7 Years )
description:
**Company Description**

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

**Build**

You'll design and deliver cloud-native features within SAP Logistics Management, using AI as a core method — not an occasional assistant — for building, reviewing, and operating software at scale. Your work will directly improve the reliability and intelligence of freight, warehousing, and supply chain processes for enterprise customers worldwide.

* Design, implement, and maintain cloud-native features in the SAP Logistics Management product using AI-augmented development methods and modern engineering practices
* Work with self-governing agent frameworks to investigate, prototype, and evaluate AI bots that reduce repetitive development and operational tasks
* Review and validate AI-generated code with a quality-first mindset — catching subtle defects, rational gaps, and security risks before they reach production
* Write precise, unambiguous requirements and acceptance criteria that enable high-quality AI-assisted implementation across the team
* Contribute to team-wide AI adoption by documenting findings, building reusable prompt patterns and skills, and sharing learnings proactively
* Participate in release decision processes, SAT testing, and quality engineering activities as a quality owner across the full delivery chain
* Support security remediation by interpreting OSC/SAST scan findings and spearheading resolution — including AI-assisted triage of security issues
* Collaborate across Germany, India, and China in an async-first, cross-cultural team model, externalizing knowledge in a form retrievable by teammates and AI tools alike

**Bring**

4 to 7 Years of Proficiency in at least one backend language (Java, TypeScript, Python, Go, or equivalent) with solid grip of clean code, SOLID principles, modularity, testability, and REST/OData API design

3+ years of professional software engineering experience in enterprise or cloud-native environments, with active daily use of AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Joule, Claude Code, or equivalent)

Has the ability to create prompts. Develops clear and effective prompts for tasks such as code generation, refactoring, debugging, and documentation. Knows how to manage context windows and improve prompts through multiple iterations.

Test-first instinct: defines acceptance criteria and writes tests before or alongside AI-generated implementation; does not rely on QE gates as the primary defect detection mechanism

Experience with CI/CD pipelines, feature toggle management, automated test coverage, and code quality tooling

Familiarity with cloud platforms (BTP, AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerized/microservice architectures

Strong written English; comfortable with async, cross-cultural collaboration across Germany, India, and China

Fluency in English is required. Experience with SAP BTP, SAP AI Core, or agent frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, or similar) is a solid advantage.

**Belong**

You'll join SAP LGM, a global engineering team actively building AI agents and intelligent logistics applications. You'll work hands-on with agentic AI initiatives, serve as a quality multiplier for the team, and shape how AI-augmented development is practiced at scale. The team values written communication, clear thinking, and knowledge that is legible to both people and AI tools. If you take quality seriously, think in systems, and want to lead from the front on how enterprise software gets built with AI — this is the right place.

 **Additional Information**

About SAP  
With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives.  
As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience.  
  
We win with inclusion  
  
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone, regardless of background, feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.  
  
SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or complete your application, please send an email with your request to the Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.  
  
For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.  
  
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy and childbirth), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.  
  
Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.  
  
AI Usage in the Recruitment Process  
  
For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process.  
  
Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.

title: Lead / Senior SAP Joule & Multi-Agent Integration Engineer
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are building the next generation of enterprise AI interoperability. As an **SAP Joule & Multi-Agent Integration Engineer**, you will pioneer our agentic AI roadmap — designing, building, and securing cross-platform agent networks that connect SAP's Joule ecosystem with ServiceNow and other enterprise platforms over open agent communication protocols. You will own the full lifecycle of agent development, from BTP provisioning through production A2A orchestration.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and deploy pro-code AI agents on SAP BTP (Cloud Foundry/Kyma) using Joule Studio, LangGraph, or SAP Cloud SDK for AI — defining agent tools, orchestration logic, and backend integrations against S/4HANA OData APIs (Orders, Quotes, Contracts, Accounts) via BTP Destination Service
* Architect and implement end-to-end A2A communication between SAP Joule and the ServiceNow platform — exposing Joule agents as A2A-compliant servers via SAP Agent Gateway, authoring Agent Cards, configuring JSON-RPC endpoints, and registering External Agent Providers in ServiceNow AI Agent Studio over Google A2A protocol v0.3.0
* Design primary/secondary agent delegation patterns, async push notification flows, and timeout-resilient pipelines across SAP and non-SAP agent networks — ensuring agents reason, delegate, and recover reliably at enterprise scale
* Configure end-to-end authentication across agent boundaries using OAuth2, SAP IAS App2App trust, and BTP Cloud Identity Services — enforcing least-privilege access, token governance, and audit-ready agent call chains
* Own the full SAP BTP stack underpinning agent workloads — AI Core provisioning, SAP Build Process Automation entitlements, Cloud Foundry runtime, Destination Service, and SAP Agent Gateway configuration
* Instrument agent pipelines with structured logging, distributed tracing, and alerting so failures are caught early, root-caused quickly, and prevented systematically across multi-hop agent calls

**Requirements**

* 4+ years of hands-on SAP BTP engineering experience, including Cloud Foundry, SAP Cloud Identity Services, and Destination Service configuration
* Proven experience building and deploying custom Joule agents in Joule Studio (pro-code path) with tool definitions wired to SAP backend systems via OData or REST APIs
* Demonstrated production experience enabling Agent-to-Agent (A2A) integration between SAP Joule and ServiceNow AI Agent Studio, including Agent Card authoring, External Agent Provider registration, credential aliasing, and A2A protocol handshake validation
* Strong command of agentic AI frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent) and multi-agent orchestration patterns, including delegation, fallback, and async response handling
* Solid understanding of API security and authentication: OAuth 2.0, mutual TLS, SAP IAS trust configurations, and BTP service bindings
* Familiarity with ServiceNow platform internals — Now Assist AI Agents, Integration Hub, Flow Designer, and Connection & Credential Aliases
* Strong grasp of distributed systems design, API performance, and fault-tolerance patterns relevant to multi-agent pipelines
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex agent topology designs for both engineering and business audiences

**Nice to have**

* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) alongside A2A for tool and resource exposure across agent boundaries
* Exposure to SAP BRIM, SOM, or BTP Integration Suite (CPI) for SAP business process integration context
* Familiarity with ServiceNow Yokohama/Zurich release features for external agent interoperability
* SAP BTP or ServiceNow certifications (Certified Application Developer, Certified Implementation Specialist)
* CI/CD experience for BTP workloads using Cloud Foundry CLI, MTA deployment, or GitHub Actions pipelines

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Manager, Software Engineering (Dot Net)
description:
We are looking for a **Senior Lead Software Engineer** to join our Technology team at Clarivate and work on the Inprotech product.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced software engineer with strong skills in .NET, Angular, SQL, and enterprise application development. We would love to speak with you if you have a strong technical background, enjoy solving complex problems, and have experience working with large-scale software applications.

**About You: Experience, Education, Skills and Accomplishments**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline, or at least 8 years of equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Minimum 7 years of experience developing web-based or enterprise applications using .NET, C#, SQL, and related technologies.
* Strong understanding of software development principles, including object-oriented programming, SOLID principles, design patterns, and clean coding practices.
* Strong technical background with experience in server-side frameworks, APIs, system integrations, and event-driven architecture.
* Good experience with SQL Server and relational databases, including writing complex SQL queries, database design, and performance optimization.
* Experience in identifying and troubleshooting application and database performance issues.
* Experience designing and developing scalable, maintainable, and secure enterprise applications.
* Experience with automated testing and CI/CD practices.
* Extensive experience working with version control systems such as Git.

**It would be great, if you also have,**

  

* Experience on frontend technologies like Angular
* Experience working with large, mature enterprise applications and modernization initiatives would be advantageous.

**What Will You Be Doing in This Role?**

  

* Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Design, develop, and maintain functionality within Inprotech, working across the application stack.
* Write clean, efficient, maintainable, and well-documented code following engineering best practices.
* Contribute to the design and development of scalable and high-performing solutions.
* Work with SQL Server and relational databases as part of application development, including developing and optimizing queries where required.
* Develop and maintain unit and integration tests as part of an automated Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipeline.
* Participate in technical design and code reviews and provide guidance to other engineers.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across application, integration, and database layers.
* Work closely with QA, Product, Architecture, and other engineering teams to deliver high-quality software.
* Contribute to the modernization and technical improvement of Inprotech, while ensuring stability and compatibility of existing functionality.
* Participate in initiatives to improve engineering processes, product quality, performance, maintainability, and technical debt.
* Mentor and support other developers and promote engineering best practices within the team.
* Stay up to date with relevant technologies and identify opportunities to improve the product and engineering practices.

**About the Team**

The engineering team is geographically distributed, with developers across India and Australia, working closely with Product, QA, Architecture, and other engineering teams across multiple locations.

The team works on a large, mature enterprise application, providing opportunities to work across modern development, complex business functionality, integrations, databases, performance improvements, and application modernization.

**Hours of Work**

This is a permanent position with Clarivate. The standard working day is 9 hours, including the lunch break.

At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations.

title: Software Engineer Specialist - Full Stack
description:
**Software Engineer Specialist - Full Stack**

**Location:** India  
**Function:** Engineering  
**Reports To:** Senior Engineering Manager

Are you...

* Interested in building scalable, reliable customer-facing cloud applications that help teams manage packaging artwork, collaboration, and approvals?
* Passionate about hands-on full stack software engineering, modern web technologies, distributed systems, and solving complex technical problems?
* Excited to take broader technical ownership across the frontend and backend, deliver intuitive product experiences, and raise the engineering bar across the team?

If so, we'd love to meet you.

Why Esko?

Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25,000 customers across 140+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation.

Our products help packaging teams collaborate, review artwork, and manage approvals with greater speed and confidence. WebCenter Go combines flexible approval workflows, artwork proofing and version comparison, project analytics and reporting, and AI-powered compliance checks in a customer-facing cloud product. In this role, you will help turn complex customer needs into simple, intuitive product experiences.

About the Role

We are looking for a **Software Engineer Specialist – Full Stack** to help build and evolve customer-facing Esko SaaS products, including WebCenter Go.

This is a deeply hands-on technical role spanning modern web applications, backend services, APIs, and distributed systems. You will partner closely with Architects, Product and UX while bringing deep implementation expertise to technical decisions and owning the detailed design, implementation, quality, performance, and operational readiness of complex capabilities.

You are expected to make sound technical decisions independently, navigate ambiguity, and balance engineering quality with pragmatic, fast execution.

You will work on customer-facing product capabilities such as artwork review and proofing, approval workflows, version comparison, and project visibility. WebCenter Go brings packaging collaboration, flexible workflows, and AI-powered checks into one controlled space. You will remain deeply hands-on while mentoring engineers, solving complex technical problems, and delivering intuitive, reliable user experiences.

What You Will Do

* Design, build, and evolve scalable full stack product features and customer-facing cloud applications.
* Own complex product capabilities end-to-end, from detailed technical design through frontend and backend implementation to production readiness.
* Remain deeply hands-on, writing high-quality code and solving complex technical problems across the stack.
* Partner with Architects, Product and UX to translate customer needs and product direction into production software, making pragmatic technical decisions and identifying trade-offs.
* Improve the reliability, performance, security, observability, testability and maintainability of our applications and services.
* Lead technical problem-solving, design and code reviews, and resolution of complex production issues.
* Mentor engineers, raise engineering standards, and champion modern development practices, including effective use of AI-assisted development.

Required Experience

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building full stack, cloud-native, or large-scale SaaS applications.
* Strong hands-on experience with React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML and CSS, including modern frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, asynchronous programming, performance optimization and automated testing.
* Strong hands-on software engineering experience with Java/JVM technologies and modern backend frameworks, designing REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.
* Experience designing and building multi-tenant SaaS applications, with a strong understanding of scalability, concurrency, consistency, availability, resiliency, fault tolerance and tenant isolation.
* Experience translating architecture and high-level designs into detailed technical designs and production-quality implementations across frontend and backend systems.
* Demonstrated ability to independently drive complex technical problems from ambiguous requirements through design, implementation and production, making pragmatic trade-offs and challenging assumptions where appropriate.
* Experience developing and operating scalable applications on AWS or another major cloud platform, with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL and Amazon DynamoDB.
* Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Git and modern software delivery practices, including automated testing across frontend, API and backend layers.
* Experience diagnosing complex production and performance problems across the stack using browser developer tools, profiling, logs, metrics and distributed tracing.
* Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical decisions through design reviews, code reviews, hands-on collaboration and sound engineering judgement.

Preferred Experience

* Experience with advanced browser technologies such as WebAssembly (WASM), Web Workers, Service Workers, IndexedDB, WebSockets, Streams or similar Web APIs, particularly for building high-performance or computationally intensive web applications.
* Experience with Scala or other functional programming languages and functional programming concepts.
* Hands-on experience with Python in addition to Java/JVM and frontend technologies.
* Experience with Kafka, Redis, Akka, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, or similar distributed technologies.
* Experience building customer-facing product capabilities, reusable UI components or design systems that support consistent, intuitive user experiences.
* Experience modernizing customer-facing web applications or large-scale distributed systems and improving engineering practices across teams.
* Experience effectively using AI-assisted development tools and helping engineering teams adopt and scale these practices across coding, testing, debugging, documentation and code review.

What Success Looks Like

* You can take a complex product capability and drive its technical implementation end-to-end, from the browser through APIs and backend services to production.
* Architectural direction is translated into high-quality, scalable, production-ready implementations.
* Customer-facing web applications and supporting services become more reliable, performant, observable, testable and maintainable while delivering intuitive, high-quality user experiences.
* Complex engineering problems across frontend, backend, and distributed systems are resolved with strong technical judgement and effective collaboration with Architects and other engineers.
* Engineers around you become more effective through mentoring, design discussions, code reviews, and hands-on technical guidance.
* Engineering standards improve through stronger code quality, automated testing, operational readiness, and disciplined implementation.
* Engineers around you make effective use of modern development practices, including AI-assisted development, to improve productivity and quality without compromising engineering discipline.
* You become a trusted technical leader in your area, known for strong engineering judgement, full stack technical depth, pragmatic decision-making, and the ability to turn complex problems into high-quality solutions quickly.

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

title: Senior Software Engineer - .Net Fullstack (Angular)
description:
**About Chubb**

Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: www.chubb.com.

**About Chubb India**

At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. We are proud to share that we have been officially certified as a Great Place to Work® for the third consecutive year, reflecting the culture at Chubb, where we believe in fostering an environment where everyone can thrive, innovate, and grow. With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we encourage a start-up mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape. We offer an environment where you will be part of an organisation that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced .NET Angular Full Stack Developer to join our Enterprise Application Services team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in .NET and Angular frameworks, hands-on experience with SQL and SSIS, and the ability to analyse and work with XML and XSLT. This role sits at the intersection of front-end and back-end engineering, requiring a developer who can deliver high-quality, scalable solutions across the full technology stack. The role also requires domain knowledge of insurance and reinsurance processes, along with flexibility to support weekend deployments and production support as needed.

**Job Description**

**Application Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain web applications using .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core) and Angular frameworks.
* Debug, analyse, and optimize existing codebases for performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following industry best practices and coding standards.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative solutions for complex business and insurance domain requirements.
* Participate in code reviews, mentor junior developers, and contribute to team knowledge sharing.

**Database & Data Integration**

* Work extensively with SQL databases — write and optimise complex queries, and demonstrate strong understanding of joins, indexes, and advanced SQL concepts.
* Analyse, develop, and maintain SQL objects including stored procedures, views, and functions.
* Design, implement, and maintain SSIS packages for ETL processes and data integration tasks.
* Analyse and work with XML and XSLT for data transformation and integration across insurance systems.

**Front-End Development**

* Build responsive, user-friendly front-end applications using Angular (Angular 8+), ensuring high performance and cross-browser compatibility.
* Develop and maintain Angular components, services, modules, and state management using RxJS.
* Ensure front-end applications are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with UI/UX best practices.

**Production Support & Deployment**

* Provide production (PROD) support as required, including troubleshooting and resolving critical issues with minimal downtime.
* Be available and willing to work on weekends for scheduled deployments and urgent production activities.
* Stay updated with the latest trends and advancements in .NET, Angular, SQL, SSIS, XML, and XSLT technologies.

**Insurance & Reinsurance Domain**

* Apply hands-on experience in the Insurance / Reinsurance domain to deliver technically sound, business-aligned solutions.
* Understand and work with core insurance processes including policy lifecycle, underwriting, claims handling, billing, renewals, and endorsements.
* Support reinsurance processes including treaty and facultative business, premium processing, claims recovery, bordereaux, and settlement workflows.
* Collaborate effectively with business stakeholders to translate domain requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Work with insurance-related data, integrations, and reporting processes.

  

**Qualifications / Key Requirements**

**Experience**

* 5–6 years of hands-on experience as a Full Stack Developer with proficiency in both .NET and Angular.
* 3–4 years of core .NET development experience (C#, ASP.NET Core, Web API).
* Proven experience in insurance or reinsurance domain applications is strongly preferred.
* Experience delivering end-to-end solutions across the full technology stack in a corporate or GCC environment.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in .NET: object-oriented programming, dependency injection, LINQ, asynchronous programming, and RESTful API development.
* Proficient in SQL: writing and optimising queries, working with joins, indexes, stored procedures, views, and functions.
* Hands-on experience with SSIS: designing, developing, and maintaining ETL packages for data integration.
* Experience analysing and working with XML and XSLT for data transformation.
* Strong Angular skills (Angular 8+): components, services, modules, state management, and RxJS.
* Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git).
* Strong debugging, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication, teamwork, and mentoring skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Entity Framework or other ORM tools.
* Exposure to Agile / Scrum development methodologies.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) is an advantage.
* Experience with unit testing and automated testing frameworks.

**Why Chubb?**

title: Software Principal Engineer - SONiC Community & System Validation
description:
**Principal Software Engineer – SONiC Community & System Validation**  
  
**Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

**Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.**

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.

We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

**Join us and help build the future of enterprise technology.**

**What you’ll achieve**

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will represent Dell System Test Engineering in the SONiC open-source community, advancing SONiC-based AI and enterprise networking solutions through validation and upstream contributions. You will work with SONiC maintainers, developers, platform partners, and engineering teams to improve feature quality, testability, and solution readiness. As a successful candidate, you will be a technically savvy, passionate engineer who independently drives and defends technical positions backed by data, and strengthens Dell’s technical presence across the SONiC ecosystem.

**You will:**

* Represent Dell System Test Engineering in SONiC working groups, technical forums, design reviews, and community initiatives, influencing SONiC community discussions with data and validation results.
* Contribute validation expertise, automation, and test infrastructure to the SONiC ecosystem, and review specifications, RFCs, design proposals, and roadmaps from a validation and customer deployment perspective, with test plans aligned to spec-driven and test-driven development (SDD/TDD).
* Validate SONiC features across functional, scale, interoperability, resiliency, and lossless-fabric scenarios, including link-level retransmission (LLR) and retransmit behavior.
* Analyze complex issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive triage and closure with engineering and community contributors, using Python and SpyTest test strategies, automation, and AI agents that improve execution efficiency, impact, and value.
* Advocate best practices in system testing, automation, observability, and quality engineering, grounding every recommendation in data, quality, and customer impact.

**Take the first step towards your dream career**

Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:

**Essential Requirements**

* SONiC and open networking: strong knowledge of SONiC architecture and open, disaggregated networking across AI, data center, and enterprise solutions, with extensive system validation across VXLAN-EVPN, MLAG, EVPN-MH, ECMP, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, SRv6, Layer 2, multicast, and enterprise services (DHCP, DNS, NTP, LDAP, RADIUS, TACACS+, 802.1X).
* Community leadership: experience in open-source communities, technical forums, or standards bodies, with strong technical leadership and communication skills to independently drive and defend technical positions using data.
* Lossless fabric validation: RoCE, QoS, DCB (PFC/ECN), lossless Ethernet, link-level retransmission, latency, performance, and resiliency across scale-up, scale-across, scale-out, rack-scale, and fabric-scale networking and compute environments.
* Automation and telemetry: strong Python and test automation skills, with CI/CD workflows, traffic generator testing (for example IXIA), packet analysis, telemetry, and northbound interfaces (CLI, REST, gNMI, NETCONF/YANG).
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering in CSE, ECE, EEE, IT, Computer Networks, Cloud Computing, or equivalent.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Hands-on SpyTest and scalable network test automation, with experience in server and storage infrastructure or fabric orchestration solutions.
* Experience building or using AI agents and AI-assisted workflows (AI models and tools, for example Claude, Devin, GitHub Copilot) for test development, automation, analysis, specification reviews, and open-source contributions.

**Who we are**

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.

Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us.

Dell Technologies is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Read the full Equal Employment Opportunity Policy here .

description:

* Experience integrating OpenAI, Google Gemini, Claude, or other LLM APIs.

Qualifications & Experience

* 2–3 years of professional experience in full-stack web application development.
* Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and Python.
* Practical experience in developing, consuming, and integrating RESTful APIs.
* Experience working with MongoDB and at least one relational database.
* Basic understanding of application architecture and system design principles.
* Good problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a development team.

What We Are Looking For

* Ability to take ownership of features throughout the development lifecycle, from implementation to deployment.

* Ability to troubleshoot technical challenges and deliver effective solutions.

Experience with Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLM integration, and cloud technologies will be considered an added advantage and is not mandatory.

description:

Azure AI Knowledge is looking for a passionate Software Engineer to join the Azure AI Search backend team. In this role, you will build large-scale, developer-facing cloud services and solve complex engineering problems across search engines, distributed systems, information retrieval, reliability, and performance. You will work in an agile, customer-obsessed environment and contribute to the core systems that index, store, and serve data for demanding search and AI workloads.

Azure AI Search is a global managed search solution. As the hosted search engine on Azure, we make it quick and easy for developers to integrate a robust set of search capabilities into their applications; Think e-commerce sites, data catalogs, large enterprise applications.

Over the last few years, the service has gone through tremendous growth, expanding into new market segments, and enabling new customer scenarios. Currently, we are sitting right in center of the AI wave enabling knowledge retrieval scenarios driving future growth, we’re working to support a broader range of customer workloads in terms of data and query volume, usage patterns, and hosting modes. Independently, we’re investing heavily to improve key drivers of customer satisfaction including search relevance and developer experience.

This is a great opportunity for anyone looking to take the next step in their career and be at the forefront of what Microsoft cares about most: Data, Cloud and AI.

As a team we’re proud of what we build and how we build it. We run lean, obsess about customers and use an evidence-based approach to decision making. Every single week we talk to customers to make sure we build what they want. We leverage open-source technologies, develop in C#, Java and C++, our codebase builds in minutes, and we ship new bits regularly. DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today's threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at www.digicert.com

**Job summary**

We're looking for a Software Engineer who combines deep Java and React expertise with strong security fundamentals, and who treats AI as a genuine part of how they work — not a novelty. You'll build the systems that aggregate threat intelligence, scan for vulnerabilities across code and dependencies, and sign and verify software artifacts — work that directly protects the software supply chain. You'll own complex problems end-to-end and raise the technical bar for the engineers around you. If you want your work to matter at scale, this is where to do it.

  

**What you will do**

* Lead the design and development of Java backend services and RESTful APIs that power Secure Release's core scanning and monitoring engine — driving architectural decisions, defining API contracts, and setting the bar for code quality across the team.
* Use AI coding agents fluently (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) as a native part of your daily workflow — and help the team do the same; bring judgment on where AI accelerates delivery and where human review is non-negotiable
* Own complex full-stack features end-to-end — from vulnerability aggregation to the React dashboards customers use to act on findings — covering everything from requirements through production, performance, and long-term maintainability
* Build and maintain the CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar) that Secure Release itself runs on and secures — including container image scanning, signing, and the deployment pipelines customers integrate with
* Work hands-on with Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm) to run Secure Release's scanning infrastructure reliably at scale
* Collaborate with Product, Design, and senior engineers to turn security requirements and threat intelligence feeds into working, testable code
* Use observability tools (New Relic, Splunk, Datadog) to monitor Secure Release's own production systems and participate in incident response when something needs attention
* Write unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, and help raise the bar on code quality and test coverage across a product that other teams rely on for their own security posture

  

**What you will have**

* 3+ years of Java development experience; familiarity with Spring Boot, RESTful API design, and basic microservices concepts
* Working knowledge of React including hooks, component design, and state management; exposure to frontend testing tools such as Jest
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes operations; willingness to grow into infrastructure-as-code practices
* Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL); ability to write and debug SQL queries and understand basic schema design
* Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and an eagerness to deepen cloud-native skills
* Curiosity and a growth mindset — eager to learn about security domain concepts and take on increasing ownership over time

  

**Nice to have**

* Academic or project-level exposure to identity and access management, digital certificates, or PKI
* Personal projects, open-source contributions, or coursework demonstrating full-stack development or security interest
* Hands-on experience or strong interest inAI/LLM integration — calling LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or embedding AI-assisted workflows into Java/React applications

  

**Benefits**

* Generous time off policies
* Top shelf benefits
* Education, wellness and lifestyle support

  

To protect candidate information and maintain a secure hiring process, all applications must be submitted through our careers portal. Resumes or CVs sent directly via email will not be reviewed or considered.

title: Lead Software Engineer (Full Stack)
description:
**BPM India Advisory Service Private Limited** - Formerly known as “Burr Pilger Mayer India Private Limited”. (BPM India) is a subsidiary of BPM LLP. Founded in 1986, BPM is one of the largest California-based accounting and consulting firms, ranking in the top 50 in the country. With 17 different office locations, BPM serves emerging and mid-cap businesses as well as high-net-worth individuals in a broad range of industries, including financial services, technology, life science, manufacturing, food, wine and craft brewing, automotive, nonprofits, real estate and construction. The Firm’s International Tax Practice is one of the largest on the West Coast and its well-recognized SEC practice serves approximately 35 public reporting companies, mostly in the technology industry.

### **Job Summary:**

The Lead Software Engineer leads a development team and owns architecture and technical delivery across integrated web applications for a tax and professional services firm. You will personally write and review production code while guiding delivery of reliable applications with a consistent, intuitive user experience. You will partner with the Product Owner, IT, security, and engineers to translate business needs into maintainable solutions, coordinate integrations, and support quality throughout the software lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Requirements and planning.** Partner with the Product Owner, business stakeholders, and vendors to clarify needs, assess feasibility, and shape the technical roadmap. Lead estimates, dependencies, and scope trade-offs; communicate progress and escalate risks.
* **Technology and architecture.** Set the technology direction and design shared sign-in, APIs, data contracts, and reusable components so applications feel consistent and changes to one do not break another. Guide intuitive navigation and interfaces with the frontend engineer and users, using lightweight prototypes and feedback. Keep designs as simple as the need allows.
* **Hands-on delivery.** Personally build foundational components and complex features, and review production code. Explain technology and build-versus-buy decisions and maintain code quality.
* **Engineering practices.** Own version control, peer review, automated testing, and CI/CD. Set practical standards and work with IT on development, test, staging, and production environments; balance features with defects, refactoring, and dependency maintenance.
* **Team leadership.** Lead and mentor developers and QA engineers, help hire and assess engineers, and resolve blockers across teams and vendors. Encourage independent delivery, document architecture and integration decisions, and share knowledge through cross-training.
* **Security by design.** Work with IT, security, and privacy stakeholders to build in access control, secrets management, audit logging, and safe handling of client data. Partner with QA and tax experts to validate business rules and release readiness.
* **Reliable releases.** Work with IT on release coordination, integration compatibility, monitoring, incident response, recovery, and documentation. Agree resilience needs and address application reliability and performance issues.
* **AI.** Partner with an AI specialist or vendor on AI-enabled features with clear permissions, human review, failure handling, and monitoring. Use firm-approved AI development tools responsibly and conventional software where it better meets the need.

**Required Qualifications:**

**Experience:** 9+ years in software engineering, including 4+ years leading developers and owning application architecture. Recent, substantial hands-on coding is required.

* **Full-stack engineering.** Recent production experience across frontend, backend services, API integration, relational databases and SQL, and secure document or object storage in one modern stack. Relevant ecosystems include .NET/C#, Java/Spring, Python, or Node.js with JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern frontend framework; expertise in every platform is not required.
* **Led and architected real applications.** Personally coded and led a team through design, delivery, integration, and support of at least two production web applications, including shared identity, APIs, data flows, and reusable components.
* **Secure application development.** Authentication, authorization, role-based access, data validation, secrets management, and secure coding for confidential information; familiarity with identity standards such as OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect.
* **Delivery and operations.** Cloud delivery, Git, CI/CD pipelines, unit, integration, API and browser testing, monitoring, and production troubleshooting. Experience with database design, migrations and performance tuning, deployment rollback, and resilience and recovery.
* **Proportionate judgment.** Select architecture that fits the need, explain build-versus-buy trade-offs, and avoid unnecessary complexity. Deliver in short iterations, refine requirements, estimate work, and incorporate stakeholder feedback.
* **Leadership and communication.** Mentoring, code review, hiring or assessing engineers, coordinating delivery, and resolving blockers. Strong verbal and written communication skills, including explaining options to a nontechnical Product Owner and collaborating across India and U.S. time zones.
* **Practical AI fluency.** Understand AI service APIs, approved-source retrieval, human review, and quality, cost, and response-time trade-offs. Use firm-approved AI development tools responsibly, verify generated code and tests, and protect confidential data; specialist model development is not required.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in tax, accounting, financial services, or another setting with sensitive data and complex business rules.
* Experience integrating enterprise systems, document workflows, approval processes, or data pipelines.
* Hands-on experience integrating or evaluating AI-enabled application features, including quality evaluation, prompt-injection defenses, and production monitoring.
* Experience with distributed systems, containers, event-driven or serverless services, with the judgment to choose a simpler design when sufficient.
* Breadth across technology platforms. Microsoft stack experience (.NET/C#, ASP.NET Core Web API, SQL Server, Azure, Azure DevOps) is a plus; the technology stack is open.

**Preferred certifications**

* A relevant cloud architecture certification, such as Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional (CSSLP). Optional; practical architecture and coding experience carry greater weight.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
**About the Role:**

GSK’s Enterprise AI team builds AI solutions that prove value fast and scale to production. The Forward Deployed Engineer is the engineer GSK sends in to find out whether an AI idea will work — embedded with business unit teams, proving ideas through PoCs, PoVs, and MVPs at a days-to-weeks cadence, then handing the proven solution off to the Sr. Solutions Engineer for scale-up. The pattern is proven by AI-native companies — Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI — and this role brings that model to GSK.

This senior engineer role embeds directly with business unit teams — product owners, engineering leads, and the wider BU — to understand the problem and execute. Most prototyping work is AI-augmented: AI coding assistants and multi-agent workflows handle the bulk of routine coding, freeing the FDE to focus on framing, judgement, and validation. The role works directly inside the customer’s business and emerges with working software and a defensible value hypothesis — not slideware. The FDE does not carry use cases through to long-term operations — clean handoff to the Sr. Solutions Engineer is part of the role.

**Why This Role Exists:**

Enterprise AI’s impact depends on engineers who can close the gap between what AI can do and what the business needs — fast, embedded, and without requiring the business to specify everything upfront. The FDE is that engineer.

* **Proves AI ideas fast** — shipping working prototypes at days-to-weeks cadence before significant investment is committed.
* **Works directly inside the business** — not at arm’s length — building the trust and domain understanding that separate useful AI from academic AI.
* **Builds the organisation’s reusable AI engineering assets** — every engagement distilled into patterns, agents, and reference architectures the whole team benefits from.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**PoC / PoV / MVP Delivery:**

* **Take ownership of high-priority BU use cases** from problem framing through to a working prototype, at days-to-weeks cadence, and form a defensible view on whether each should progress.
* **Ship first production versions** directly for use cases where the path is clear — before the Sr. Solutions Engineer takes them forward to scale.

**AI-Native Engineering:**

* **Operate AI agent workflows** (planning, coding, testing, review, documentation) for autonomous prototype delivery — selecting the right level of automation for each engagement.
* **Use AI coding assistants** as the default mode of building; provide judgement, course-correction, and validation.

**Customer Embedding & Handoff:**

* **Embed with BU teams** — attend standups, understand the domain, prototype against real data and real workflows.
* **Package proven use cases cleanly** for the Sr. Solutions Engineer — working code, architecture rationale, open risks, and scaling concerns.

**Governance, Standards & Coaching:**

* **Begin Code Orange, Responsible AI, and Accountability Report conversations** during prototyping — so the productionisation team does not inherit governance debt.
* **Contribute reusable agents, prompt templates, and reference architectures** to the organisation’s pattern library after each engagement.
* **Form and defend kill/continue recommendations** at the end of each engagement — presenting clearly to BU and Enterprise AI leadership.
* **Coach BU engineers on AI-augmented ways of working** while embedded, building BU capability alongside delivery outcomes.

**Required Functional Experience:**

* Overall 15+years of full-stack or AI/ML engineering experience, including production deployments.
* Demonstrated ability to take ideas from sketch to working software at speed — startup, lab, or innovation-team background is ideal.
* Strong proficiency in Python and at least one of TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or similar.
* Hands-on experience with GenAI patterns: agents, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, prompt engineering, and evaluation.
* Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Databricks AI Assistant) as the primary mode of development.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Prior experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer at an AI-native company (Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI, or similar), or as a Customer Engineer / Solutions Architect at a hyperscaler.
* Experience in regulated industries (pharma, healthcare, financial services) and familiarity with GxP, GDPR, and SOX.
* Working knowledge of fine-tuning fundamentals and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
* Track record of contributing reusable engineering patterns back to a broader team.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Master’s degree/ Ph D in Mathematics, statistics, computer science or related field is advantageous.

**Skills**

Artificial Intelligence (AI), Artificial Intelligence Ethics, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNS), Classification Models, Deep Learning, Intelligent Automation (IA), Machine Learning (ML), Model Evaluation, Model Validation, Predictive Modeling, Probabilistic Modeling, Python (Programming Language), Test Documentation

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack, YouTube Creator Support
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience with full stack development, across back-end such as Java, Python, Golang, or C++ codebases, and front-end experience including JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS or equivalent.
* Experience with Generative AI and full-stack web development.
* Experience programming in C++, Python or Java.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
* Experience testing, maintaining, and launching software products.
* Experience with software design and architecture.
* Experience integrating Generative AI tools or large language model (LLM) interfaces into software workflows.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Creator Support team designs and builds systems to support millions of creators through authoritative data, creator-facing products, intelligent workflow platforms, and advanced technologies like Generative AI-powered assistants. Our work directly impacts the growth of YouTube by scaling high-quality, trustworthy support to a much larger cohort of creators, making every interaction easy, helpful, and empowering.  
  
We are an autonomous, cross-functional team owning end-to-end product and engineering strategy for creator support, with product management, user experience design, and user research.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. title: SAP BW Consultant
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

As a Senior SAP BW/ABAP Developer & Support SME, you will be responsible for designing, developing, enhancing, and supporting SAP Business Warehouse solutions that enable enterprise reporting and analytics. You will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional SAP teams to deliver scalable data warehousing solutions, ensure data integrity, and provide expert-level production support across SAP BW and ECC environments.

  

**What will you do:**

* Design, develop, and maintain SAP BW data models, extraction processes, transformations, and reporting solutions.
* Build and support BW objects including DataSources, InfoPackages, DTPs, DSOs/ADSOs, InfoCubes, Composite Providers, Open Hub extracts, and master data models.
* Develop and optimize ABAP-based BW routines, user exits, and custom enhancements.
* Design, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain complex Process Chains and data loading processes.
* Perform root cause analysis and resolution of production incidents, data discrepancies, and reporting issues.
* Support and maintain integrations using DB Connect, UD Connect, SDKs, and external data sources.
* Analyze data flow across DataSources, transformations, InfoProviders, and reporting layers to ensure data quality and consistency.
* Collaborate with functional teams across FICO, SD, MM/Procurement, EWM, SCM, and Planning domains to understand reporting requirements and deliver effective solutions.
* Participate in the full SAP BW lifecycle including design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Ensure adherence to development standards, quality assurance processes, and performance optimization best practices.  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Experience:**

* 10+ years of hands-on experience in SAP Business Warehouse (SAP BW) development and support.
* Expertise in SAP BW 7.x including extraction, modeling, query design, and BW-related development.
* Strong experience with BW Extractors, Master Data, DSOs/ADSOs, InfoCubes, Composite Providers, Open Hub, DTPs, InfoPackages, and Process Chains.
* Proven experience in developing Expert Routines, Start Routines, End Routines, and BW-specific ABAP enhancements.
* Advanced debugging skills across SAP BW, ABAP, and SAP ECC environments.
* Experience supporting SAP BW 7.4 on ABAP Stack SP19 and SAP ERP ECC 7.3 environments.
* Strong understanding of ETL processes, data warehousing concepts, and reporting architectures.
* Expertise in troubleshooting process chain failures, data load issues, and complex production incidents.
* Experience with external connectivity technologies including DB Connect, UD Connect, SDKs, and SQL-based integrations.
* Strong working knowledge of SAP ECC integration and support for both 3.x and 7.x DataSources.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Demonstrated experience in at least two end-to-end SAP BW implementations or multiple large-scale support engagements.  

  

**Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:**

* Experience serving as a SAP BW Subject Matter Expert (SME) in global enterprise environments.
* Strong functional understanding of SAP modules including FICO, SD, MM, Procurement, EWM, SCM, and Planning.
* Experience supporting large-scale reporting and analytics environments with high data volumes.
* Knowledge of performance tuning and optimization techniques within SAP BW.
* Exposure to hybrid SAP landscapes and integration with external data platforms.
* Experience leading incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ability to troubleshoot ambiguous or intermittent system issues with minimal error definitions.
* Strong documentation, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing capabilities.
* Experience working in complex production support environments with stringent service-level agreements (SLAs).
Exposure to SAP BW modernization initiatives and migration projects is an added advantage.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

**Workforce Strategy, Planning & Optimization**

* Act as a techno-functional partner to the workforce planning team, with an understanding of strategic workforce planning, demand forecasting, capacity planning, resource planning, workforce analytics, and demand-capacity alignment.

* Support planning and review cycles through data-driven insights, scenario analysis, decision support, and visibility of actions and outcomes.

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
About Lilly
  
At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to create medicines that make life better for people around the world. The Digital Engagement Tech@Lilly team builds solutions and capabilities for Marketing, Corporate Affairs and Medical organizations globally, and owns the consumer platforms and the governance around them.
  
  
This role exists because the hardest problems in our space are not solved from a ticket queue. As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you will sit with business, medical and marketing teams, understand how they actually work, and build working AI-enabled software with them, fast. You will go from a vague problem to a live product in weeks, then take what you learned and turn it into reusable patterns for the rest of the organization.
  
  
Role Overview
  
A forward deployed engineer is a senior, hands-on builder who works at the point where technology meets the business problem. You will be embedded with stakeholder teams, own outcomes end to end (discovery, design, build, deploy, adoption), and stay close enough to users to see what works and what does not.
  
This is a senior individual-contributor role. You will spend most of your time building, across the front end, back end and AI layer, while working directly with product owners, system custodians, architects and compliance partners. You will operate with minimal supervision, set patterns and standards for others to follow, and mentor developers and engineers around you. Success means shipping reliable, well-governed solutions that people use, and that move a business metric.
  
  
What You Will Build
  
  

* Customer-facing and internal web applications in React, Nuxt or Vue, backed by Node.js APIs, built directly with business teams and shipped on short cycles.
* Agentic and LLM-powered workflows for content, engagement and medical use cases: multi-agent orchestration, tool use and intelligent automation of manual work.
* RAG and semantic search solutions over enterprise content and data, including embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking and Text2SQL where it fits.
* Production AI services and APIs that integrate with enterprise data platforms, content systems and downstream product workflows.
* Reusable patterns, templates, and accelerators that turn a one-off solution into something other teams can adopt.

Key Responsibilities
  
Embed and discover
  
  

* Embed with business, medical and marketing teams to understand their workflows, pain points and constraints first-hand.
* Frame ambiguous problems, decide what is worth building, and be direct about what is not feasible.
* Prototype quickly, put working software in front of users early, and iterate on their feedback.

Build and deliver end to end
  
  

* Design and build full-stack solutions: responsive front ends, API integrations, Node.js services and the data layer behind them.
* Integrate LLMs, RAG, agents and AI services into products, with evaluation, guardrails and monitoring for quality, latency and cost.
* Own the delivery lifecycle: scoping and estimation, development, automated testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring and support handover.
* Work with the technical lead and system custodian to keep what you ship maintainable, observable, and secure.

Architecture and standards
  
  

* Make architectural decisions that improve efficiency and maintain compliance in a regulated space.
* Turn what you learn in the field into reusable components, templates, and reference implementations for cross-functional teams.
* Set and uphold coding standards, review practices and engineering patterns across teams.

Responsible AI, security and governance
  
  

* Apply secure-by-design and privacy-by-design principles, and build in traceability, grounding, auditability and human oversight.
* Work with quality, compliance and risk partners, so solutions meet regulatory and enterprise requirements, including content review processes.
* Maintain clear architecture, design, and support documentation for everything you put into production.

Mentoring and influence
  
  

* Provide hands-on technical guidance to developers and engineers, review designs and code, and raise the bar through practical examples.
* Communicate trade-offs, risks and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leaders.
* Bring practical feasibility, scalability, and value considerations into roadmap planning.

Required Qualifications
  
  

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of building and shipping production systems end to end.
* 4+ years building customer-facing or business-facing solutions in close partnership with stakeholders, such as forward deployed, solutions engineering, consulting engineering or embedded product engineering roles.
* Expert in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript and React, with Nuxt or Vue a plus; strong in responsive design and web standards.
* Strong back-end experience with Node.js (Express, Koa or Hapi) and API design and integration (REST, GraphQL).
* 2+ years of hands-on generative AI delivery: LLMs, prompt and context engineering, RAG, embeddings, agentic workflows, and evaluation of model outputs.
* Working proficiency in Python and SQL, and experience with frameworks such as LangChain, DSPy or Hugging Face.
* Strong experience with unit and integration testing frameworks such as Jest, Mocha, Chai or Jasmine.
* Experience designing, deploying and operating services on a major cloud (AWS preferred), with CI/CD, containers and monitoring.
* Strong system design and architecture fundamentals: version control (GitHub), code reviews, and secure, maintainable, observable code.
* Experience working in Agile teams, including scoping, estimation and backlog ownership.
* Proven ability to turn ambiguous business problems into scalable solutions with measurable value, and to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Pharmaceutical, healthcare or other regulated-industry experience, including working within content review, privacy and compliance processes.
* Experience with multi-agent systems, tool use, Text2SQL, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and LLM evaluation.
* Experience with vector databases, lakehouse platforms (such as Databricks), and enterprise AI platforms (such as SageMaker or Azure ML).
* Experience fine-tuning or adapting models, and optimizing AI systems for quality, latency, throughput and cost.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions and MLflow, or equivalent LLMOps tooling.
* Experience working across multiple concurrent projects and with stakeholders in different countries and time zones.
* Experience building developer tooling, internal platforms or accelerators that other teams adopt.
* Familiarity with web experience platforms, CMS and content operations.

Professional Skills and Education
  
  

* Comfortable in ambiguity: you move without a spec, make sound calls with incomplete information, and know when to ask.
* High ownership and self-direction, with the maturity to work with minimal supervision.
* Strong communicator, written and verbal, who can earn trust quickly with senior business stakeholders.
* Pragmatic builder who favors working software and fast feedback over perfect plans.
* Curious and quick to learn new technologies, with a drive to improve existing business and technical processes.
* Strong coordination skills and the ability to balance several projects at once.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and collaboration in a professional setting.

**Education:** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering or a related technical field. A master's degree is preferred. Equivalent practical experience is considered.

Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.
