title: Software Development Engineer, RBS Tech
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you excited about building the future of Retail Automation powered by Generative AI?  
  
Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon's Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enriches ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination, where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow; and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops intelligent automation powered by GenAI, LLM and Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of highly complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills. Our solutions ensure that information in Amazon's catalog is complete, correct and comprehensive enough to give Amazon customers a great shopping experience every time.  
  
Why join us  
  
We believe in "Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History" value by having a strong focus on sharing learning experiences from the front line with the development teams. So, the options for people in the team are vast. If you like mastering a domain and going deep, we need you. If you love designing elegant abstractions for messy real world problems, we need you. If you love the benefits of process and methodical improvement, you will love it here. If you get a kick out of seeing your code improve the shopping experience for millions of customers worldwide, we definitely need you. If you want to keep your head down, headphones on, and bash out code to support the team, we have a spot for you too.  
  
About the role  
  
At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world's most beloved brands, customer obsession is part of our company DNA. We are seeking a Software Development Engineer II to join the SAMAI team and help us push the boundaries of what's possible with Generative AI in retail automation. As an SDE2, you will not just write code, you will architect systems that think. You will design scalable, distributed platforms that orchestrate LLM powered agents, build robust pipelines that process millions of data points daily, and make critical design trade offs that directly influence a multi billion dollar business. You will work at the intersection of Generative AI, distributed systems and real world business impact. Every system you build will be tested against the unforgiving scale of Amazon's catalog, hundreds of millions of ASINs, dozens of marketplaces and billions of customer interactions. You will collaborate closely with Applied Scientists and senior engineers to turn cutting edge research into production systems that work at scale. You will constantly stretch the boundaries of innovation to tackle the business challenges.  
  
If you enjoy designing and building GenAI powered platforms, highly distributed systems that can scale and solving challenging problems, come join us!  
  
Work/Life Balance  
  
RBS Tech team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn't about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it's about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
  
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring, detailed and constructive code reviews. We have casual coffee chats with Principal and Senior Engineers from RBS Tech. You get an opportunity to network and have technical conversations around your work, technical challenges, suggestions, ideas and proposals. You can also seek advice and discuss about things outside work, like, life in general, your family, hobbies etc. We provide trainings to the employees through online learning platforms such as O'Reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications. And on a team building Gen AI systems every day, the learning opportunities are endless.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  
We are looking for a sharp, experienced Software developer with a diverse skillset and background. As a SDE-2, your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.). You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers. You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric reviews. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. You take on projects and make software enhancements that improve team software and processes. You are able to train new team-mates on how your team’s software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture.
  
  
About the team  
  
We are building SAMAI, our Gen AI powered automation platform that is redefining how RBS delivers at scale. SAMAI harnesses the power of LLMs, agentic AI workflows and cutting edge ML to automate complex retail business processes end to end. Think of it as the brain behind RBS's next generation automation, orchestrating intelligent agents that can reason, act and deliver outcomes that previously needed hundreds of human hours. We are not just using Gen AI as a feature; we are building a platform that makes GenAI the foundation of retail operations.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
We are looking for a sharp, experienced Software developer with a diverse skillset and background. As a SDE-2, your work is consistently of high quality. title: Full Stack Developer - Manager
description:
**Role purpose**
----------------

You'll build cloud-native services and user interfaces for a multi-year programme modernizing a large portfolio of middle-office applications and moving them to AWS. This is a **hands-on development role** with a strong back-end focus. You'll design and build Java microservices and APIs on AWS, and also contribute to ReactJS/TypeScript front ends. You'll use **AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Devin** every day to deliver faster, while staying fully accountable for the quality and security of the code.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Back-end development (primary)**

* Design and build **Java/Spring Boot** microservices and REST APIs for trade processing, accounting, reconciliation and settlement functions.
* Build event-driven integrations with **Kafka and IBM MQ** , including message design, error handling, retries and idempotency.
* Write efficient data access against **Oracle** (JPA/Hibernate and SQL), working with database engineers on schema design and performance.
* Rebuild legacy business logic as clean, testable services, working with business analysts and subject-matter experts to confirm behaviour.
* Write unit, integration and contract tests, and help with performance and resilience testing.

**AWS**

* Build and deploy services on **AWS** : ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, SQS/SNS, RDS, CloudWatch and IAM.
* Design services for scalability, high availability and security, following AWS Well-Architected principles.
* Work with DevOps on Terraform, Docker and CI/CD pipelines (Harness/GitHub Actions) so your services deploy automatically.

**Front-end development (secondary)**

* Build and maintain **ReactJS/TypeScript** screens and components for data-heavy enterprise applications that replace legacy desktop UIs.
* Connect front ends to back-end APIs, handling authentication (SSO/MFA), state management and error handling.
* Write maintainable **JavaScript/TypeScript** and component tests (Jest/React Testing Library).

**AI-assisted development**

* Use **GitHub Copilot** for inline code completion, chat-based refactoring, test generation and pull-request summaries.
* Use **Claude Code** for agentic, multi-file work in the terminal: understanding unfamiliar codebases, refactoring across modules, generating tests and fixing failing builds.
* Work with **Devin** (or similar autonomous agents) on well-defined tasks: write clear task specs, review its pull requests and correct its output.
* Use AI to analyse legacy code (Java EE, Sybase SQL, PowerBuilder, COBOL) and draft specs for subject-matter experts to confirm.
* Write good prompts and context files (e.g. README files, coding standards, agent instruction files) so AI tools produce code that follows team standards.
* Review all AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance and licence compliance before merging. You stay accountable for every line.
* Share effective prompts, patterns and lessons learned with the team.

**Ways of working**

* Take part in code reviews, design discussions and agile ceremonies.
* Support production releases, cutovers and early-life support, and fix issues quickly.
* Follow State Street secure coding, information security, data classification and approved-AI-tool policies.

**Required experience and skills**
----------------------------------

* 6+ years in software development, mostly on the back end.
* **Java:** strong in Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Data/JPA, REST API design and multithreading.
* **Messaging:** practical experience with Kafka and/or IBM MQ.
* **AWS:** good hands-on knowledge of core services (ECS/EKS or Lambda, S3, SQS/SNS, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch).
* **Databases:** strong SQL; experience with Oracle or another enterprise relational database.
* **ReactJS/TypeScript/JavaScript:** good working knowledge of React hooks, component design, TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
* **AI tools:** proven, regular use of at least one of GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or Devin in professional delivery, including the ability to judge when AI output is wrong.
* **Engineering practices:** Git, CI/CD, Docker, automated testing (JUnit, Mockito) and clean code principles.
* Experience working in agile delivery teams.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Hands-on experience with **all three** of GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Devin, and a view on which tool suits which task.
* Experience with MCP servers or giving AI agents context from Jira, Confluence or code repositories.
* Experience in financial services, ideally investment servicing or middle-office areas (trade lifecycle, settlement, collateral, reconciliation or accounting).
* Experience modernizing legacy applications (e.g. Java EE/EJB on Payara or WebSphere, Sybase).
* Experience with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code.
* AWS Developer Associate or Solutions Architect certification.

**Success measures (first 12 months)**
--------------------------------------

* Delivered production-ready services and front-end features for modernized applications, on schedule.
* Services meet agreed standards for test coverage, performance, security and observability.
* Measurable productivity gains from AI tools (e.g. cycle time, test coverage), with no rise in defects or rework.
* Contributed reusable prompts, agent instructions or patterns that the wider team uses.
* Became a trusted contributor in design and code reviews across the team.
  

  

**About State Street**
======================

  

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

  
  

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. description:
**About** **JazzX AI****:**

***Vision:*** *Enterprises operating on institutional intelligence—governed, self-improving, and scalable beyond individual expertise.*

JazzX AI is defining the future of enterprise work—by building AI-native digital workers that actually get the job done.

We believe enterprises don't scale expertise—they lose it. Knowledge stays trapped in individuals, judgment gets applied inconsistently, and the best talent spends time on work that should run itself. We're changing that.

JazzX AI transforms messy enterprise reality into institutional intelligence: governed digital workers that capture expert judgment, make every decision explainable, and continuously improve through real-world execution. The result is faster decisions, higher-quality outcomes, and reliable execution at scale—in domains where getting it wrong isn't an option.

We're starting with lending and due-diligence workflows—complex, regulated, high-stakes. From here, we're building the backbone for enterprise intelligence across industries.

This is early-stage, hard, and consequential work. If you want to be part of bringing AI systems to market that actually run in production, handle real complexity, and deliver real outcomes—not demos, not chatbots—JazzX AI is the place.

**About** **SAIGroup** **:**

SAIGroup a private investment firm that has committed $1B to build and scale next-generation, AI-powered enterprise software companies. SAIGroup's portfolio serves 2,000+ global enterprise customers, generates nearly $800M in annual revenue, and employs 4,000+ people worldwide — providing JazzX AI with long-term capital, deep operating expertise, and access to real-world enterprise scale from day one.

**The Role**

As a Senior Full Stack AI Engineer at JazzX AI, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and enhancing innovative, high-performance AI-driven solutions. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams — AI/research engineers, software engineers, architects, product managers, and designers — to translate complex platform and product requirements into elegant, scalable, and modular AI,software, and infrastructure components.

You'll independently build end-to-end applications — from pixel-perfect frontend to robust backend services and AI agent integrations. You thrive in a fast-moving environment where you leverage AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot) and vibe coding to rapidly prototype, build, and ship production-grade features. You don't just use AI — you build with it and build on top of it.

**Senior Full Stack AI Engineer**

* Drive architecture decisions for new features and services end to end
* Lead the design and development of high-performance, scalable services using a cloud-first approach
* Build and ship complex, multi-service features with minimal oversight
* Mentor engineers and foster their growth and development, elevating team velocity through tooling and best practices
* Design scalable patterns for AI agent orchestration, data pipelines, and micro-frontends
* Champion DevOps and AIOps best practices for AI services, including robust monitoring and alerting strategies, observability, privacy, and security
* Lead technical planning and shape the team's AI-native development culture
* Typically 5–8+ years of relevant experience with demonstrated technical leadership

**What You'll Build**

**AI-Powered Applications:**

End-to-end products combining LLM agents, document intelligence, and knowledge graphs to automate complex enterprise workflows

**Intelligent Frontends:**

Rich, responsive React/TypeScript UIs with real-time streaming, document viewers, code editors, and interactive data visualizations

**Backend Services:**

High-performance, scalable microservices (Python/FastAPI, Node.js, or Java) with async patterns, event-driven architectures (Kafka, Celery), and robust API layers — using a cloud-first, cloud-agnostic approach

title: Engineer II, Full Stack Engineer
description:
**About the Role:**

Enterprise AI (EAI) builds AI products that combine real modelling work with user-facing applications and ships them to production. Full Stack Engineers move across data, models, platforms, APIs and interfaces in a single workflow. In our operating model, digital workers do much of the hands-on build. They generate services, APIs, interface components and tests, run evaluations and monitor what is in production. Our engineers set the architecture and standards that work is built to and own the quality of what ships.

EAI products and agents draw on a governed context layer that makes data, meaning, permissions and history retrievable at the moment they are needed. Full Stack Engineers build the products and agents that consume it, and decide how that context reaches users.

The Full Stack Engineer II independently builds and ships AI-integrated features, working closely with GSK business teams to prototype against real data and workflows at a days-to-weeks cadence. The role owns the quality of what digital workers deliver in those features, makes evidence-based calls on what to continue or stop, and contributes reusable components others adopt.

**Why This Role Exists:**

* **Takes AI ideas from problem framing to working software** at a days-to-weeks cadence, building with digital workers and owning the quality of what ships.
* **Qualifies problems before committing to them,** challenging underspecified asks and forming evidence-based recommendations on what to continue or stop.
* **Raises the team's standards** through code review, documentation and reusable components that others adopt without rework.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Delivery & Experimentation:**

* **Own use cases from problem framing through working prototype and first production version,** at a days-to-weeks cadence and without close supervision.
* **Qualify incoming asks:** challenge underspecified problems, assess feasibility and define scope before committing to work. At the end of each piece of work, form and defend an evidence-based recommendation to continue or stop, presented clearly to business and EAI leadership.
* **Work closely with business teams,** prototyping against real data and workflows and building trusted relationships with product owners and engineering leads.

**Agent-Operated Engineering:**

* **Build with digital workers as the default mode of engineering:** direct them, validate what they generate and course-correct at engineering speed. Review, test and approve their work within the remit EAI's operating model sets, and escalate what falls outside it.
* **Design and orchestrate multi-agent workflows end-to-end,** and judge when agentic approaches add value over simpler alternatives.

**Platforms & APIs:**

* **Design and ship backend services independently** with observability, clear contracts and compliance with non-functional requirements.
* **Choose API design patterns that suit the consumer and** iterate on them based on real integration feedback.

**AI Integration & Context**:

* **Build AI-integrated features independently,** including RAG pipelines, tool use and multi-step LLM workflows that draw on the governed context layer with the right permissions and provenance.
* **Test AI-powered features with structured evaluation frameworks** before and after release.
* **Raise Responsible AI and governance considerations from the prototype stage,** so work that moves to production does not inherit governance debt.

**AI-Native Experience:**

* **Deliver complete UI features with measurable user engagement,** bringing user feedback directly into build decisions.
* **Build AI-powered interfaces with appropriate transparency:** confidence signals, error states, provenance and human-override paths.

**LLMOps & System Health:**

* **Build evaluation pipelines and LLM-specific monitoring** for your features, including output quality signals, model drift and guardrail compliance.
* **Respond to AI production incidents with structured diagnosis,** and see them through to a fix.

\

**Standards & Reusable Components:**

* **Build reusable components, SDKs, agents, prompt templates and reference architectures** adopted by engineers outside your own pod, and drive consolidation where you find duplication.
* **Raise team standards through code review, documentation and direct feedback,** and resolve systemic quality issues in the codebase.
* **Hand work on cleanly when it moves to another team,** with working code, architecture rationale, open risks and scaling concerns.

**Required Experience:**

* 10+ years of full-stack or AI/ML engineering experience, including production deployments.
* Demonstrated ability to take ideas from sketch to working software at speed, independently and under time pressure. A startup, lab or innovation-team background is an advantage.
* Strong proficiency in Python and at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, Go or similar, with experience designing and shipping backend services and complete UI features.
* Hands-on experience with GenAI patterns: agents, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, tool use, prompt engineering and evaluation, including evaluation pipelines and LLM-specific monitoring in production.
* Daily use of AI coding agents as the primary mode of development, with sound judgement on what to accept, change or reject.
* A track record of raising team standards through code review and documentation, and of contributing reusable engineering patterns that others adopted.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Prior experience as a Full Stack Engineer, Customer Engineer or Solutions Architect, ideally at an AI-native company or hyperscaler.
* Experience in regulated industries, such as life sciences, healthcare or financial services, and familiarity with GxP, GDPR and SOX.
* Working knowledge of fine-tuning fundamentals and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Skills**

AI Frameworks, Computer Programming, Data Preprocessing, Deep Learning, Full Stack Development, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for Machine Learning, LLMOps, Machine Learning Algorithms, Microsoft Azure Data and AI, ML Frameworks, Model Evaluation, Model Training, Model Validation, RAG Pipeline, TypeScript

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Senior Solution Consultant IT - JD Edwards
description:

Our technology stack is diverse and future-oriented, built on a solid mix of COTS and SaaS solutions that we continuously evolve to meet the demands of the next generation of manufacturing.

**Who are you?**

title: Solution Builder (Technical Builder)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**The Experience**

  

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You’ll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

  
  

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

  
  

What You'll Actually Be Doing

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
* Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.
  

  

You're Our Person If...

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* You’re fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
* You’ve been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you’d change.
* You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
* You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what’s coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.
* You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.
  

  

Even Better If...

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

description:
**Company Description**

**Eurofins Scientific** is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

title: Software Engineer I - FullStack
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the team**
------------------

The App Components Team is a forward-thinking, platform-focused product engineering team dedicated to crafting the cohesive, high-performing building blocks that define Rippling’s "Enterprise Studio" experience.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a **Software Engineer I (Full Stack)** on this team you will be responsible to build and scale the systems that power these components. While your primary focus will be on the backend, this is a truly full-stack role. You will help design the distributed systems that power our platform and also contribute to React and React Native code to deliver polished end-to-end product experiences.

You will be responsible for building scalable backend services, APIs, and data models, while partnering closely with product and design to ensure the underlying complexity is translated into seamless, high-performance user experiences.

**What you will do**

* Design and implement scalable backend services using Python and Golang to support complex enterprise data modeling and product use cases.
* Contribute to systems that operate at scale, with exposure to distributed systems challenges and technologies such as Kafka, Flink, and AWS.
* While your strength lies in backend engineering, you will also contribute to the frontend codebase. You will write high-quality React and React Native code to ship end-to-end features and help deliver intuitive, performant UI components.
* Take ownership of meaningful product initiatives from early problem definition through implementation. You will help shape technical designs for new "App Studio" capabilities and deliver robust solutions.
* Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code, participate in thoughtful code reviews, and contribute to strong engineering standards across backend and frontend systems.
* Work closely with Product, Design, and other engineers to break down complex user problems and build components that are technically strong and practically useful for teams building on top of them.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 1+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong experience building production systems
* Proficiency in building scalable backend services. Experience with Python, Django, Golang, MongoDB, and AWS is highly preferred.
* Comfortable in writing and shipping production code in React and React Native. You should understand component lifecycles, state management, and mobile constraints well enough to build and iterate on UI for the systems you own.
* Ability to design scalable, reliable systems and reason through trade-offs such as consistency, performance, and fault tolerance.
* Experience building reusable systems, frameworks, or developer-facing components is a plus. You should be excited by building flexible foundations that can support multiple product use cases over time.
* A track record of independently driving projects, navigating ambiguity, and delivering high-quality outcomes.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

* Solid understanding of application security, observability, performance optimization, and reliability engineering

title: Senior Software Engineer- Full Stack
description:
Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Its suite of products — including the Greenlight app, debit card, Safe Family GPS trackers, and Family Hub — brings together financial tools, safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience. Designed for busy families who want convenience without compromise, Greenlight continues to innovate alongside the evolving needs of modern life. Today, more than 6.5 million family members trust Greenlight to stay in sync.

At Greenlight, we're here to make the day-to-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. That's why we get out of bed every morning.

Greenlight is looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer focused for our Web Core team. This team focuses on core web initiatives including bringing the core Greenlight functionality on the web for the first time and functioning as a horizontal platform team to support other web teams. This includes setting standards, defining best practices, building common libraries and mentoring other web developers. You will be expected to also make contributions to our backend services as required to accomplish the team deliverables.

This role reports to a Senior Director, Engineering

### **Technologies we use:**

* Node.js
* React, NextJS, Remix
* REST,Express
* AWS, Kubernetes (EKS)
* Kotlin experience preferred

### **Your day-to-day:**

* Product development - Building new experiences for the Greenlight website. Work with domain teams, product managers and designers to bring different parts of the Greenlight mobile application experience to web
* Platform - As part of the web core team, you will have to support all web development within Greenlight. This includes providing mentorship and support for web teams, defining standards, best practices and determining technologies
* Working in a strong team to quickly deliver on our web products.
* Work with product and design teams to continuously add incremental features while balancing new features and tech debt
* Scaling and maintaining our backend services to evolve with new feature requests and support our growing user base
* Improving the reliability and availability of the platform which supports our families and partners

### **What you’ll bring to the team:**

* BS degree in Computer Science or equivalent
* 6+ years software development experience
* The ability to context switch frequently in a fast-paced environment
* An eye towards performance, scalability, and observability
* Experience building single page applications using a modern framework
* Experience building REST apis
* Recent experience building backend services using node.js.
* Understanding of how to execute well on the build/measure/learn process and lean startup skills

### **Preferred experience:**

* Experience with A/B testing and experimentation
* Experience working with modern MarTech tools such as Segment, Optimizely, Mixpanel, etc

**Who we are:**

It takes a talented team to aim for a mission like ours. We're looking for people who ask "is it bold enough?" People who bring their real selves to the table and push the people around them to do the same. We win by never hesitating to jump in, offer a hand, or share the credit, because we know we're stronger together than apart. And through all of it, the mission stays the thing we measure ourselves against: are we doing right by the families counting on us? If that sounds like your kind of team, we'd love for you to apply.

title: Senior Principal Cloud Foundations Engineer – Full Stack
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Principal Cloud Foundations Engineer – Full Stack builds and runs the Internal Hosting Portal that allows application teams across GSK to provision and manage Cloud resources in a self-service manner. The Hosting Portal is a custom-built web application using a modern TypeScript tech stack based on TypeScript. The full stack engineer sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through autoamted software deployment rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

* Overall, 15 years and Typically 6-8 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Excellent knowledge and hands on experience with HTML5, CSS3 (including preprocessors) and TypeScript (ES6+).
* Excellent knowledge and hands on experience with React and NextJS
* Hands-on experience with GraphQL and relevant tooling such as Yoga, Prisma, and Apollo Client
* undefined
* Good understanding of bundlers and compilers such as Webpack, TS-Node, Rspack and Babel.
* undefined
* Previous experience in developing a React-based UI Component library based on Mantine, Material UI, or Chakra UI.
* undefined
* Familiar with popular patterns and libraries such as React Hooks, state management, and Redux.
* undefined
* Previously developed schema-based forms either custom or based on a library such as react-hook-form or Formik, including data validator libraries such as Yup, Zod or JOI.
* undefined
* Expertise with CSS grid systems, media queries, flex and other layout techniques and responsive user interface components.
* undefined
* Knowledge of modern authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth v2 or SAML and JSON Web Token and libraries such as MSAL.

  

* Strong experience with test automation (unit & integration) tools such as Jest and Cypress.

**Desirable:**

* Familiar with building React web applications based on a Micro Frontend using Module Federation or Single SPA.
* undefined
* Developed REST APIs based on NodeJS (ExpressJS).
* undefined
* Experience of building and deploying web applications through CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
* undefined
* Knowledge of deploying, managing and monitoring web applications in a Cloud environment such as Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* undefined
* Previously worked in a central IT team within a regulated environment such as the Pharmaceutical or Finance industry.

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Deployment, Cloud Financial Operations, Component Libraries, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Full Stack Development, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Quality Engineering, Secure Authentication, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Test Automation, Virtualization

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. title: Senior Cloud Modernization Java Full stack engineer
description:
Be Part of Us:

Innovation is and will always be the core of SAP Fioneer.

SAP Fioneer builds on a heritage of outstanding technology and a deep understanding of corporate and consumer demands. At the heart of it all it is simple: We bring financial services to the next level with innovative software solutions and platforms.

We are empowering companies in the financial services industry to achieve speed, scalability, and cost-efficiency through digital business innovation, cloud technology, and solutions that cover banking and insurance processes end-to-end.

A global company, with rapid growth, innovative people, and a lean organization makes SAP Fioneer a place where you accelerate your future!

About the Role :

We are undertaking a strategic modernization initiative to transform an established Spring-based Java web application from a modular monolith (modulith) into a modern cloud-native platform.

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Modernization Java Full Stack Engineer who is passionate about evolving enterprise software and has experience modernizing existing applications rather than only building greenfield solutions.

You will contribute to current product development while helping shape and execute a modernization roadmap that improves scalability, maintainability, developer productivity, observability, and deployment automation.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys balancing practical business delivery with long-term technical transformation.

Key Responsibilities:

Product Development

* Design and implement new application features across frontend and backend components.
* Develop robust REST APIs and business services using Java and Spring technologies.
* Participate in solution design, code reviews, testing, and release activities.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, UX designers, QA engineers, and DevOps teams.
* Collaborate effectively with geographically distributed teams, ensuring seamless communication and coordination for successful project outcomes.
* Improve application quality through automated testing and clean coding practices.

Modernization & Cloud Transformation

* + Assess existing application architecture and identify modernization opportunities.
* + Incrementally evolve the modulith architecture toward cloud-native design principles.
* + Modernize deployment pipelines and development workflows.
* + Improve observability through logging, metrics, tracing, and monitoring.
* + Introduce cloud-native patterns where they provide measurable business value.
* + Define strategies for service decomposition and bounded contexts when appropriate.
* + Help establish engineering standards, best practices, and architectural guardrails.

Engineering Excellence

* + Champion automated testing, CI/CD, code quality, and secure development practices.
* + Mentor other engineers and contribute to technical leadership within the team.
* + Drive performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability improvements.
* + Participate in architecture discussions and technical decision making.

  
**Requirements**

Job Requirements:

* 8+ years of professional software development experience.
* Strong proficiency in Java and experience with Kotlin.
* Strong hands-on experience building modern web applications using TypeScript and React, with proficiency in state management solutions such as Redux and modern frontend tooling.
* Extensive experience with Spring Framework, Spring Boot, and RESTful APIs.
* Cloud native development experience on platforms like Azure (Preferred) and knowledge of Cloud Foundry
* Experience working with large enterprise applications and legacy modernization initiatives.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented design principles and (Cloud) software architecture patterns.
* Strong experience in (Cloud) Security to promote secure and compliant code.
* Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, SAP HANA, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2.
* Experience with automated testing frameworks and test-driven development practices.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in distributed teams.
* Be fluent in English

  
**Benefits**

Benefits:

You will have the opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry on an incredibly ambitious project to shape the ever-evolving financial sector. This is an environment where you can have it all - the agility, enthusiasm and dynamism of a start-up, combined with the established expertise, solid market presence and extensive customer network of a more established organisation.

At SAP Fioneer, you will benefit from a flexible work environment that encourages creativity and encourages you to think outside the box, bring new ideas to the table, and challenge the status quo. You will become part of a diverse and global team that we are proud of and are constantly growing and reinventing. As an employee, you will have the chance to chart your own career path and take advantage of competitive compensation packages and progression opportunities based on merit.

Join us for a rewarding career where your needs are not just met but exceeded

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**About Enterprise Bot**
------------------------

Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI, and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. **Your first months at Enterprise Bot**
---------------------------------------

We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer with 2–4 years of experience who enjoys working across both frontend and backend and wants to build products at the intersection of software engineering and AI.

You’ll work on our AI-powered products and platforms, building everything from interactive user interfaces and dashboards to APIs, backend services, integrations, and AI-powered workflows.

We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of a feature end-to-end — understand the requirement, design the solution, build it, test it, and get it into production.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Full Stack Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications across the frontend and backend.

### **Backend & APIs**

### **Frontend**

* Build modern web interfaces using React and TypeScript.

* Create reusable UI components and contribute to frontend architecture.
* Ensure applications are responsive, accessible, and performant.
* Work closely with Product and Design teams to turn ideas into intuitive user experiences.

### **AI & Agentic Systems**

You’ll be working in an AI-first engineering environment.

* Integrate LLM APIs and AI capabilities into production applications.
* Work with AI-powered workflows and intelligent automation.
* Build or integrate agent-based systems and tool orchestration.
* Work with AI APIs, inference workflows, prompt orchestration, and model integrations.
* Explore new approaches to building AI-powered product experiences.
* Stay curious about emerging AI technologies and developer tools.

You don't need to be an AI/ML researcher. We’re looking for strong software engineers who are excited about learning and building with AI.

### **Quality, Performance & Reliability**

* Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
* Write unit and integration tests using tools such as Jest, Mocha, or Chai.
* Debug issues across frontend, backend, APIs, and databases.
* Identify performance bottlenecks and improve application scalability.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.
* Document technical solutions, APIs, and architecture where required.

### **Collaboration**

* Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, AI Engineers, QA, DevOps, and other developers.
* Participate in technical discussions and architecture decisions.
* Break down product requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Take ownership of features and deliver them from **concept**  **production**.
* Contribute to a collaborative and fast-moving engineering culture.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

* 2–4 years of professional experience in full-stack software development.
* Strong experience with JavaScript / TypeScript.
* Strong backend development experience with Node.js.
* Good hands-on experience with React and modern frontend development.
* Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL APIs.
* Strong understanding of MongoDB and experience with at least one SQL database such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Good understanding of asynchronous programming, promises, async/await, and event-driven architecture.
* Experience with authentication and authorisation mechanisms such as JWT and OAuth.
* Good understanding of software development best practices, testing, debugging, and version control.
* Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Ability to troubleshoot production issues and work independently.
* Good understanding of responsive web development.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Good communication skills and ability to work in a cross-functional team.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience with AI/LLM integrations.
* Experience working with AI agents or agentic workflows.
* Experience with real-time systems or event-driven architectures.
* Exposure to voice technologies, streaming, speech-to-text, or text-to-speech.
* Experience with Redis or other caching technologies.
* Experience with microservices architecture.
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience working in a SaaS or B2B product company.
* Exposure to AI coding assistants and AI-powered development workflows.

**What We Value**
-----------------

At Enterprise Bot, we value ownership over titles.

We're looking for someone who:

* Doesn't wait for instructions for every step.
* Can take a problem and figure out how to solve it.
* Is comfortable working in a fast-changing startup environment.
* Cares about the quality of what they build.
* Is curious about AI and new technologies.
* Enjoys learning and experimenting.
* Can balance speed with good engineering practices.
* Is comfortable working across different parts of the technology stack.

**Benefits**
------------

* Build products at the forefront of GenAI and Conversational AI.
* Work on real-world AI products used by international enterprises.
* Get exposure to LLMs, AI agents, automation, voice, and real-time systems.
* Work with a global engineering and product team.
* High ownership and the opportunity to make a visible impact.
* Flat hierarchy and an open, collaborative culture.
* Opportunity to learn and work with rapidly evolving AI technologies.
* Competitive compensation and strong opportunities for growth.

**Join our team**
-----------------

If you're excited about building full-stack products and want to work where software engineering meets AI, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Software Development Engineer 1
description:
**About the Team & Role**

Team builds the infrastructure that keeps commercial drivers and fleets moving from fuel payments at the pump to the apps and backend services that power authorizations, loyalty, and real-time transaction data. As an SDE I, you'll join one of two full-stack engineering teams within WEX's Mobility organization.

  
  

Both teams own their systems end to end. The 10-4 (OTR) team builds the over-the-road platform customer-facing APIs, event-driven microservices (Java/Spring Boot, Python), Kafka-based async

processing, payment and identity integrations (Fiserv, Okta), and the Android and iOS apps that drivers use in the field. The NA Mobility Platform team builds and owns the shared frontend infrastructure that product teams across the organization depend on Angular micro-frontends with NestJS BFFs, Module Federation, a shared component library (Theseus UI), brand theming, and app scaffolding via Theseus Builder. In both cases, you'll work across layers of a real production stack, ship to real users, and be supported by engineers who care about doing the work well. We value clean APIs, strong testing habits, and engineers who improve the systems they touch. You'll work closely with the product, other OTR teams, and your peers on features from design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.

  
  

**How You'll Make an Impact**

* Build specific components within an established architecture.
* You'll follow the patterns your team has set, whether that's microservices, event-driven design, or component-based frontend, and implement features correctly within those structures rather than redefining them.
* Write clean, compilable code with unit tests that meet the team's quality standards.
* Before you start building, you'll ask the right questions about acceptance criteria and error states so you're solving the right problem, not just writing code.
* Identify and fix bugs in well-defined tasks.
* You'll reproduce issues, pinpoint where in the code they're happening, and work with senior engineers to land the right fix rather than just patching the symptom.
* Handle low-priority support tickets as a first responder and participate in on-call rotations under supervision.
* During incidents, you'll run specific checks and scripts as directed, building your confidence with live systems gradually and safely.
* Contribute to basic observability by adding error and info logging that helps the team debug issues.
* You won't be expected to triage complex production problems alone, but your logs should make it easier for others to do so.
* Keep the team's process running smoothly. That means updating Jira daily, following the
* Definition of Done, moving tickets through the right stages, and raising a flag immediately if something is at risk.
* You don't deviate from the team's agreed process without checking first.
* Show up fully in team rituals like standups, backlog grooming, and demos.
* You'll listen to stakeholder feedback during demos to understand how your work actually lands with users, not just whether it passed the acceptance criteria.
* Use AI tools like Cursor or similar to reduce boilerplate, get unstuck faster, and understand error messages more quickly. You own the quality of everything you ship though, which means validating AI-generated output rather than passing it through unchecked.
* Update documentation when you find something inaccurate or missing. Good documentation is part of the job, and you'll be expected to keep it honest as you learn the system.
  

  

**Experience You'll Bring**

* You have a solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, and software design from a B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science from a reputed institution, with 0 to 1 year of professional experience.
* You're comfortable writing clean, compilable, tested code in at least one of Java, Python, or TypeScript/JavaScript, and you understand what makes code maintainable, not just functional.
* You understand the testing pyramid and have written unit tests as part of coursework, an internship, or a personal project. You see tests as part of the feature, not an afterthought.
* You know never to hardcode secrets, you have a basic understanding of IAM and role-based access control, and you're willing to learn which compliance requirements like PCI or SOC apply to the systems you work on.
* You know your way around Git and pull requests, can deploy to an existing CI/CD pipeline, and can tell when your specific commit caused a build failure.
* When you're blocked, you ask focused questions and explain what you've already tried. You flag a deadline risk the moment you see it, not the day before it's due.
* You receive code review feedback without getting defensive, you actively learn your team's standards and tools, and you're comfortable switching between tasks within a project when priorities shift.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A degree in computer science software engineering from a reputed institution.
* Internship or co-op experience where you shipped real code to a production or staging environment as part of a team.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
* Familiarity with cloud basics even through coursework or personal projects.
* Exposure to containerization through Docker. Reading and running existing Dockerfiles counts, you don't need to have written them from scratch.
* Some experience working in an existing codebase, contributin improvements, and navigating code you didn't write yourself.
* Awareness of AI tools beyond code completion, such as experimenting with prompt design or modifying a simple AI-powered script or agent.
* A genuine interest in the domain. Payments, fleet operations, or developer platform work are exciting problem spaces and it helps to be curious about the industry, not just the technology.

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Are you passionate about leading teams that operate infrastructure at scale? Do you thrive on overseeing Kubernetes clusters and microservices? Here is an exciting opportunity for you!

  
  

Our team provides Kubernetes platform-as-a-service to other teams building microservices at Salesforce. Over the next year, we will expand our Kubernetes footprint by thousands of clusters, and you could play a pivotal role in this transformation. As a manager, you will guide your team in working with open-source technologies like Kubernetes, Terraform, Argo, and Spinnaker, shaping the future of these technologies while fostering a culture of innovation.

We manage one of the largest Kubernetes fleets in the industry and have been early adopters of this technology. Our mission is to empower service owners to focus on the unique value of their services, enhancing developer agility while reducing operational costs and complexity. The FKP team is critical to the company’s strategy to move to Hyperforce, providing the underlying infrastructure for key services such as Sales, Service, Commerce, Mulesoft, and Tableau.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

title: Sr. Software Engineer (Full Stack - Frontend)
description:
Navan has transformed the corporate travel, payment, and expense landscape by consistently prioritizing user needs. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer on the **Enterprise Team**, you will be a technical leader helping to build the "operating system" of our corporate travel platform. Our team owns the critical infrastructure that allows companies to function globally—managing everything from granular travel policies and dynamic approval workflows to user identity and enterprise-grade analytics.

This is a high-impact role where you will bridge the gap between complex backend logic and intuitive user experiences. You will collaborate closely with a talented team of engineers, product managers, and designers to build sophisticated configuration tools, real-time dashboards, and seamless integration flows that empower our customers to manage their travel programs at scale.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Architect User Experiences:** Drive the frontend architecture for our Admin and User portals. You will build highly responsive, accessible, and performant user interfaces that handle complex data sets and configuration flows.
* **Build Enterprise-Grade Workflows:** Create intuitive, state-heavy UIs for complex business domains—such as configuring dynamic travel policies, visualizing multi-tier approval chains, and managing user roles—while developing the backend API endpoints to support them.
* **Collaborate on Design & UX:** Partner closely with our Product Design team to implement pixel-perfect interfaces, contribute to our shared UI component libraries, and establish frontend best practices across the engineering organization.
* **Develop Supporting Backend Services:** Build and evolve the robust Java/Spring Boot backend services, APIs, and data integrations necessary to power your frontend features.
* **Own Features End-to-End:** Take technical ownership of a problem domain from the user interface down to the database, facilitating the design, development, and launch of key features that directly impact our users.
* **Drive the Vision:** Partner with engineering and product leadership to identify user pain points, plan the long-term technical roadmap for the frontend architecture, and serve as a subject matter expert on UI/UX engineering.
* **Champion Best Practices:** Contribute to a culture of technical excellence by writing high-quality code, implementing robust frontend testing strategies (e.g., unit, integration, and E2E testing), mentoring other engineers, and advocating for operational reliability.

  

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **4+ years of experience** in software development, building complex systems for SaaS products or consumer-facing web applications in a fast-paced environment.
* **Frontend Expertise:** Deep, hands-on experience (4+ years) in frontend development using modern frameworks like **React, Angular, or Vue**, along with deep proficiency in **TypeScript**. You should be highly skilled in managing complex application state and optimizing rendering performance.
* **Backend Proficiency:** Solid experience with backend development using **Java and Spring Boot**, including hands-on experience with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL), data modeling, and query optimization to support your frontend features.
* **Global Mindset:** Demonstrated experience with and a strong passion for web accessibility (A11y) and localization (l10n) best practices to serve a diverse, global user base.
* **Systems Architecture:** Experience designing and implementing scalable applications across microservices, distributed systems, and cloud platforms like AWS.
* **Collaborative Ownership:** Demonstrates strong ownership and a collaborative mindset, with clear communication skills and a proven ability to ship production-quality code equipped with robust monitoring and documentation.
* **AI-Enabled Workflow:** Ability to effectively leverage AI development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, CodeGPT, Claude, and Cursor) to accelerate development and innovate on engineering workflows while maintaining high standards for code quality.
* **Bachelor's or Master's degree** in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent hands-on experience.

Navan uses AI-assisted Automated Employment Decision Tool (Metaview) to assist with evaluating resumes against job qualifications for this role. All final decisions are made by human recruiters and hiring managers.

**Human oversight:** Metaview does not automatically reject candidates or make final hiring decisions. Our recruiters and hiring managers review all outputs and make the final hiring decision regarding every application.

* **Your rights:** If you prefer to have your application reviewed without AI assistance, you may request a human evaluation by entering your email here. Your decision to do so will not affect how your candidacy is evaluated.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about our processing of personal data, and your rights.

Tecsys is trusted by mission-critical organizations in healthcare and distribution to power resilient, efficient and secure supply chains. We are a global provider of cloud-based, AI-driven software, publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: TCS).

**Three values guide how we work**. We earn trust daily by valuing the customer and acting with integrity. We build each other up by recognizing individual strengths and working as one team. And we explore boldly by staying curious and adapting for success.

You’ll join a culture driven by curiosity, continuous learning, and people who challenge what’s possible.

***What You Bring***

* Comfort using AI-assisted development tools to understand code and deliver changes, with the judgment to review what they produce.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills in an Agile environment, and a willingness to work on both legacy and modern components. Experience with application modernization is a plus.

 **Benefits**  

* Benefits (Insurance and access to learning platform) and vacation from day one
* Hybrid work-mode.
* Flexible work environment
* Room to learn, stretch and take on new challenges

* Collaboration with global teams
* We foster an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive.
