**Business Justification as to why this hire is required, is this a backfill or additional headcount:**

  

Additional senior engineering capacity is required to execute the architectural transition of the Synergy Bluetooth host stack from APSS to the Q6 low-power domain. The role will strengthen full-stack Bluetooth ownership, accelerate architecture and product problem solving, and enable scalable development across XR and Wearables programs.

**Job Overview - Dept Description and Job Duties:**

  

The Bluetooth Common IP team is seeking a highly analytical and hands-on Senior Engineer to design, develop, port, integrate, and sustain Bluetooth host software across APSS and Q6/LPI environments. The engineer will be a key contributor to the full-stack architecture in which Bluetooth host protocols, profiles, application services, and supporting platform interfaces progressively evolve to meet Days of Use (DOU) targets for our products in XR & Wearables.

  

This is an implementation-focused role for an exceptional developer who can work from Bluetooth specification and system architecture through detailed design, efficient C code, integration, debugging, and productization. The engineer is expected to use AI-assisted engineering responsibly to accelerate understanding, development, reviews, test creation, failure analysis, and documentation while independently validating all outputs.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Bluetooth stack development: Develop and maintain Bluetooth Classic, Bluetooth Low Energy, and LE Audio host protocols, profiles, services, and product-specific use cases.

* Platform adaptation: Port or redesign OS, memory, threading, timer, storage, security, IPC, transport, logging, and diagnostic dependencies for a resource-constrained low-power execution environment.

* Architecture and interfaces: Define clean, scalable module boundaries and APIs between the Bluetooth stack, controller transport, audio services, offload framework, OEM applications, Android/APSS services, and Q6 platform components.

* End-to-end ownership: Own features from requirements and feasibility through design, implementation, unit testing, integration, interoperability, performance optimization, issue resolution, and release support.

* Protocol analysis: Translate Bluetooth Core and profile specifications into robust implementations and use protocol-level reasoning to diagnose failures across host, controller, transport, peer device, and application layers.

* Performance and robustness: Optimize memory footprint, compute utilization, latency, concurrency, power behavior, and recovery paths for embedded and low-power targets.

* AI-assisted engineering: Use approved AI coding and analysis tools to accelerate code comprehension, solution exploration, test generation, log triage, documentation, and repetitive development tasks. Apply engineering judgment, security discipline, source review, and thorough validation before adoption.

* Collaboration and technical leadership: Partner with Bluetooth firmware, audio, systems, platform, application, test, product, and customer engineering teams. Drive design reviews, mentor engineers, identify risks early, and communicate decisions and trade-offs clearly.

  

Qualifications needed

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

* 6+ years of embedded software development experience, with strong hands-on development in C/C++ for wireless connectivity or comparable embedded products.

title: Software Engineer (Full Stack
description:
Software Engineer (Full Stack)

Maersk is hiring Software Engineers who can work across the stack to join the Visibility Platform team. The platform answers the questions "where is my shipment?" and "when will I get it?" with a high level of accuracy and timeliness. It is powered by tons of data from multiple sources, and this role provides an opportunity to innovate on how the right subset of that data is processed, served and presented to users in the right context.

About the role

In this role, you will work on a greenfield project that aims to provide increased quality of visibility into the movements of containerised shipments and associated attributes like delays, extra charges incurred, emissions, etc.

You will lead and own the features you pick up from first prototype to production, working across the tech stack. You will move comfortably between the front-end and the back-end, using modern coding agents to move fast and teammates for review and guidance.

Here are some of the things the role involves:

* Independently lead and own the design, delivery and long-term health of the features and services you build.

* Contribute freely to both the web front-end and the back-end services, using coding agents to explore unfamiliar code, produce working changes, and learn conventions as you go. Take responsibility for what you ship, regardless of who or what wrote the first draft.

* Work closely with the UX and product team to iterate and provide feedback on mocks and designs and how well they solve user problems.

* Build quick prototypes for exploring concepts. Be happy to throw some away and evolve others into solutions that are maintainable for a long time.

* Work backwards from the mocks and help design API structures that can power the views in an efficient and performant manner. Where existing APIs can be limiting, help explore alternate options in design that don't degrade the originally intended user experience.

* While building views, care deeply about semantic HTML, accessibility and rendering

performance, often with each going hand-in-hand with the other.

* While building services, build event driven applications and microservice-based APIs with a lot of focus on scalability, reliability and secure practices from the ground up.

* Work with Maersk's design system conventions and ensure consistency in design language across multiple micro-applications. Know when the conventions can be limiting and be comfortable stepping out of them.

* Ensure hygiene practices like test coverage, performance profiling, security checks etc. are put in place and gated with automated checks.

* Ensure applications emit the standard signals needed for effective monitoring and alerting.

* Actively participate in code reviews and encourage using them as a tool for team members to learn from each other. Review agent-assisted changes with the same rigour as any other.

* Contribute to a culture of continuous delivery where the path from code commit to going live is as automated as it can be.

* Work in an inclusive manner with team members across geographies, time zones and cultures.

About you

Here are some things we expect from you for the role.

Minimum qualifications

* Be highly proficient with either the back-end or the front-end, as described below. This is the minimum bar, and you should be able to independently lead and own delivery of major components, pages or services there with very little hand-holding.

* Back-end: Java or Kotlin and a framework like Spring Boot, with experience building event driven applications and microservice-based APIs that handle a huge amount of data.

* Front-end: Vue, React, Svelte or Angular, TypeScript, semantic HTML, modern CSS and responsive design. We mainly use Vue, so be open to it.

* Be able to contribute across the other side with the help of coding agents: enough familiarity to read the code, judge what an agent produces, write and run tests, and know when to ask a teammate for a second pair of eyes.

* Be adept at using modern LLM-based coding agents (like Claude Code or GitHub Copilot) to increase quality and speed of work, including giving them good context, verifying their output,and recognising when they are going wrong.

* Be highly proficient with a test framework like JUnit or Jest, and be a natural at always

maintaining high test coverage for any code written.

* Be familiar with analysing the algorithmic complexity of code, common design patterns and when to use them.

* Be familiar with at least one relational and one NoSQL database, and with observability concepts: logging, metrics, traces and alerts.

* Be familiar with cloud computing concepts and able to put them into practice, with experience in at least one of Azure, Google Cloud or AWS.

* Be familiar with a build system like Webpack, and with Node.js and the npm ecosystem. Be aware of common reusable open-source libraries, and mindful of not causing bloated dependencies.

* Be open to deep dives into new areas of the tech stack and learn new skills on the go.

* Be a stickler for developer productivity, and always be on the lookout to get things done more efficiently.

* Be effective at written and spoken communication. Also exhibit the same in writing code that can be well understood by other developers.

Preferred qualifications

* Be highly proficient on both sides: the back-end and the front-end described above, rather than one with agent-assisted contribution to the other.

* Be familiar with browser-based testing frameworks like Cypress to automate end-to-end user workflow tests, and with Core Web Vitals and how to build pages that render blazing fast, with measurements set up to be monitored continuously.

* Have an eye for extracting patterns for reusability that help ensure consistency across multiple applications.

* Previous experience working with visual elements like maps and charts that help display a massive amount of data in aggregated form.

* Prior experience working with Kafka, or with containerised 12-factor apps and tools like Docker and Kubernetes.

* Knowledge about the logistics and supply chain domain.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  
  
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**Position Description**
  
We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join the Advanced Integration Builder team within Okta. This team builds and maintains the backend services, provisioning frameworks, authentication connectors, and next-generation Entitlement Management engines that let Okta customers secure, integrate, and govern access to thousands of third-party enterprise applications — from modern cloud platforms (Microsoft Office 365, Workday, Salesforce, AWS, ServiceNow) and AI agentic systems to legacy on-prem systems. As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design and implementation of integration components end-to-end: REST/SOAP API clients, OAuth2/SAML authentication flows, user and group provisioning/sync jobs, and the retry and rate-limiting logic required to operate reliably against dozens of idiosyncratic third-party vendor APIs at scale. This is a backend-intensive role — the large majority of your time will be spent in Java/Spring Boot services — but you'll also need decent frontend experience in React and JSP to build and extend the screens that surface integration configuration to customers

  

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**
  

* Feature Execution: Drive technical design and implementation of integration features — new app connectors, provisioning/sync capabilities, authentication flows — primarily in backend Java services, extending into React/JSP configuration screens.
* Build and maintain REST/SOAP API clients, OAuth2/SAML authentication handlers , and vendor-specific exception/error-mapping layers for third-party SaaS and enterprise applications.
* Implement and extend user/group provisioning adapters built on shared contracts and scheduled sync/import jobs that keep identity data consistent between Okta and external systems.
* Resilience at Scale: Apply retry/backoff, rate-limiting, and pagination strategies to handle vendor API quirks, throttling, and intermittent failures gracefully across the dozens of concurrently supported integrations.
* Security & Compliance: Ensure credential/secret handling, token exchange, and audit logging for provisioning operations meet Okta's security and compliance standards.
* Product & Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with PMs, support, and technical leads to prioritize new app integrations, resolve customer-reported connectivity issues, and participate in technical interviews/recruiting.
* Operational Excellence: Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues in integration pipelines, drive root-cause analyses, and improve observability/alerting for sync and provisioning jobs.
* Code Quality & Technical Standards: Participate in code reviews, write thorough unit and functional tests, and maintain clear technical documentation.

**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
  

* Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience building and operating reliable, production-grade backend services.
* Backend Expertise: Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot; comfortable owning services end-to-end from design through production support.
* Distributed Systems: Experience with asynchronous job processing, scheduled/batch sync jobs, and event-driven patterns.
* Data Management: Proficiency with relational databases (MySQL) and caching layers (Redis or similar).
* Resilient Systems Design: Practical experience with retry/backoff strategies, rate-limiting, and handling pagination/throttling quirks from third-party APIs.
* API Design: Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, including clients for third-party vendor systems with varying levels of API quality and documentation.
* Problem Solving & Ownership: Ability to break down ambiguous integration requirements and independently drive a feature from design to production.
* Decent Frontend Experience: While the role is backend-dominant, you should be comfortable building and modifying UI in React and JSP — well enough to independently deliver the frontend without relying on a dedicated frontend engineer.

**Nice to Haves**
  

* Experience with identity/IAM standards (SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OIDC) or directory services (AD, LDAP).
* Integration & Auth Protocols: Working knowledge of REST/SOAP API integration patterns and authentication standards such as OAuth2, SAML, or WS-Federation.
* Exposure to legacy protocol support (SOAP-based provisioning services) alongside modern REST/OAuth integrations.
* Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architectures or specialized compliance environments (e.g., FedRAMP/GCC-High).
* Experience with message brokers/queueing systems (Kafka) for asynchronous processing.
* Exposure to HTTP mocking/test-server frameworks (e.g., WireMock or equivalent internal mock-server tooling) for API-level testing.

**Education**
  
B.E./M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Software Development Engineer, SW-Device OS
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile consumer electronics. Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally creating the best-selling Kindle family of products. Since then, Lab126 has produced devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV, Amazon Echo, and Dash Button.  
  
The Device OS team is central to creating these innovative devices, providing the core OS, platform, features, and components. We are inventing the future of consumer electronics and are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help bring that vision to life — solving real-world challenges that transform our customers' experiences. The team builds scalable solutions that enable our partners to quickly and cost-effectively develop and launch new device experiences.  
  
If you love being hands-on designing and implementing high-quality platforms for consumer electronic devices while working alongside a world-class, highly accomplished team, we'd love to talk with you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Engage in the design and development of core OS, platform, and embedded software components, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.  
Partner closely with Product Management to detail and disambiguate requirements.  
Design, implement, and ship high-quality embedded software for a wide range of Amazon Devices, from concept through launch.  
Own the quality of your own work — both code and design — and help junior team members meet or exceed the quality bar.  
Diagnose and resolve complex issues across the stack in resource-constrained environments.  
  
A day in the life  
In our team, you will get to build products and features from the ground up. You will define and build features and tools used by thousands of developers for building for millions of customers. We work across multiple internal teams as well as product to define what we are building and make it a reality. SDEs on this team are actively writing code, as well as working on designs and mentoring others. As the Device OS org we get to work horizontally across many exciting new device types.

------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Associate Engineer - Digital Technology
description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top\-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.  

  

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.  

**Description**
---------------


Are you a Developer looking for a new technical hands\-on role? Do you want to join a growing Software Development team?  

Are you interested in cutting edge technologies, with the ability to collaborate with your fellow software developers?  

Are you thrilled by having an opportunity to fly around the world on employee pass while working on innovative and critical software applications?  

If you answered yes to any of the above, we have an exciting role for you within our Digital Technology practice to enhance and build industry\-leading platforms while transforming our customer’s travel journey as a software leader. United’s Digital Technology team designs, develops, and maintains massive\-scaling technology solutions brought to life with innovative architecture, data analytics, and digital solutions.  

United Airlines is growing faster than ever, and we need talented software engineers / developers like you to fill the critical openings across our business. This is a hybrid position with ample flexibility working from home or at the office. Annual base salary/bonus incentives, along with exciting travel opportunities with free flight travel (on employee pass) benefits.

 **Our Values**


At United Airlines, we believe that inclusion propels innovation and is the foundation of all that we do. Our Shared Purpose: "Connecting people, Uniting the world" drives us to be the best airline for our employees, customers, and everyone we serve. We can only do that with a truly diverse and inclusive workforce. Our team spans the globe and is made up of diverse individuals all working together with cutting edge technology to build the best airline in the history of aviation.


With multiple employee\-run "Business Resource Group" communities and world\-class benefits like health insurance, parental leave, and unlimited space\-available travel, United is truly a one\-of\-a\-kind place to work making you feel welcome, accepted, and like you truly belong. Be part of our team and help us make a positive impact on the world. Diverse candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.

 **Job overview and responsibilities**


This role plays an important role in creating and maintaining software solutions supporting United's Airport Operations applications. This role is to develop, design, create and modify software applications/systems to support core business functions. This individual will apply proven technical (best practices and patterns), communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills to help develop/design/implement software applications/systems to maximize IT's benefit to United Airlines.

* Participate in the design, development, and planning for the software architecture for United’s technology platforms
* Solve complex performance problems and architectural challenges.
* Participate in code reviews.
* Serve as an integral member of the development team to create practical solutions in Agile/DevOps environment
* Ensure consistency with an established software development architecture
* Analyze and interpret requirements from Business and UX Design Team
* Introduce new technologies and best practices as needed to solve business problems
* Help to troubleshoot, test, and maintain the quality and security of the platform
* Work in an Agile environment
* Strong team player and good communicator

 **This position is offered on local terms and conditions. Expatriate assignments and sponsorship for employment visas, even on a time\-limited visa status, will not be awarded. This position is for United Airlines Business Services Pvt. Ltd \- a wholly owned subsidiary of United Airlines Inc.**

**Qualifications**
------------------

**What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):**

* B.E./B.Tech. in a related technical field, or equivalent experience, education or training.
* 1\- 2 Years of experience as Full Stack Developer.
* Strong foundation in programming paradigms and architectural concepts, including object\-oriented programming, data structures and algorithms and database systems.
* Experience in .NET, Angular and microservices architecture.
* Familiarity with AWS Services like S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, Step function, ECS, EKS.
* Experience in writing quality code and on time delivery of quality components and or applications
* Experience at component and unit testing of following standard practices and methodologies
* Effective verbal and written communication skills with a strong team\-player mindset.
* Good understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile methodology.

 **What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):**

* 12 months\+ of experience developing applications in Full stack.
* 12 months\+ of experience building RESTful APIS using .Net Frameworks.
* 6 months \+ of experience building UI components using Angular or similar type script frameworks.
* Hands\-on working experience with messaging brokers.
* Familiarity with software engineering best practices that drive enterprise\-wide improvement, including DevOps and Observability.
* Experience in AI tools like Copilot, Gemini or Claude Code or similar
* Experience working with Git/GitHub code repositories.

description:
**About Rippling**

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

* Work closely with Product, Design, and other engineers to break down complex user problems and build components that are technically strong and practically useful for teams building on top of them.

**What you will need**

* 1\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong experience building production systems

Hiver is a modern, AI\-driven customer service platform used by companies across healthcare, finance, logistics, education, and technology. We help teams deliver fast, human support across email, chat, phone, WhatsApp, and more — without the complexity of legacy helpdesks.  

We’re a **challenger brand** in a category dominated by over\-engineered tools. We build software that is simple, powerful, and genuinely helpful, and we operate internally with that same philosophy. As an **SDE III (Full Stack)** at Hiver, you will work end\-to\-end across frontend, backend, and AI systems to craft the next generation of collaborative email, automation, and AI\-powered customer service workflows.  

You will own major product surfaces, architect scalable systems, and bring intelligent experiences to life in the UI – while ensuring reliability for 5M\+ emails processed daily across thousands of active users.### **Key Responsibilities**

**Full\-Stack Product Engineering:*** Build intuitive, performant UIs in React/Next.js for email collaboration, analytics, and AI\-assisted workflows.
* Ship features end\-to\-end across frontend, backend APIs, domain models, and data pipelines.
* Integrate AI suggestions, copilots, and retrieval\-based workflows seamlessly into the product experience.
* Collaborate closely with design \& product to deliver polished, consumer\-grade UX.

* Build low\-latency inference and retrieval endpoints, caching layers, and model\-serving pipelines.
* Improve reliability, resiliency, and performance across monolith and microservices environments.
* Work with Kafka/RabbitMQ to build high\-volume, event\-driven data flows.
* Partner with ML/AI teams to deploy embeddings, rerankers, RAG systems, and evaluation workflows.

  

**Data, Security \& Observability:*** Implement secure, compliant data handling for structured/unstructured customer data.
* Own observability across the stack — tracing, metrics, dashboards, feature flags, SLOs.
* Lead debugging of complex issues across frontend, backend, infra, and model pipelines.
* Drive postmortems, root\-cause analysis, and process improvements.

  

**What we’re looking for?**  

Must Have:* 5\+ years building and scaling production systems end\-to\-end.
* Strong proficiency in React/Next.js \+ TypeScript.
* Solid backend expertise in Go/Java/Python.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, performance, and resiliency.
* Experience with SQL plus familiarity with NoSQL/caches.
* Exposure to production model serving (embeddings, RAG, inference APIs).
* Strong fundamentals in cloud infra (AWS preferred), containers, and CI/CD.

* Familiarity with vLLM, Triton, TorchServe, or model quantization.
* OpenTelemetry, feature flag platforms, A/B testing systems.
* Prior experience building B2B SaaS or email/collaboration products.

  

### **About Hiver**


We specialise in delivering innovative solutions and exceptional services to meet the diverse needs of our clients. With a strong commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, we strive to exceed expectations and drive success in every project we undertake.
